reasoning: A rectangular speech bubble containing an exclamation mark is the standard UI glyph for 'send feedback' or 'report an issue', and naturally reads as an urgent message, complaint, or announcement. It fits tasks centered on reporting bugs, sending urgent texts/notices, or giving feedback, though it must not be used merely to mark any unrelated task as high-priority.

pass1.ambiguity: Standard icon for 'Send Feedback' in Google Material Design; can also be read as an urgent chat message, a delivery failure on an SMS, or a general warning notice.
